verdict: Meta ads went dark Sep 9 — leads have stopped and restart is underway.
narrative: Meta advertising has delivered zero spend since September 9 — five consecutive days with no ads running — against a daily target of $65–75, and lead volume has stopped as a direct result. Over the full 28-day window you received 30 leads at a cost of $46.95 per lead from $1,408.56 in total spend, but those results belong to the earlier weeks; the current week produced nothing. Separately, leads that do arrive are not moving through your intake pipeline — 30 leads were recorded by ad tracking while your CRM shows 24 contacts and zero opportunities created, a gap we are working to close with CRM and automation setup that is being completed this month. Meta is being restarted immediately, and once spend resumes you should expect lead volume to recover toward prior-period levels within days.

cost per lead over the last 28 days — unreadable as a benchmark until ads are running again
actions on your Google Business Profile this period, showing steady organic presence while paid ads were paused
